Name: Buff_Mana_Surge
Description: Increases spell damage by 1% for 5 seconds for every 100 maximum mana.

Name: Buff_Warhound
Description: A temporary minion that taunts enemies and deals damage.

Name: Buff_Tactical_Advantage
Description: Increases movement speed and damage by 35% after using a movement ability.

Name: Buff_Plague
Description: At 10 stacks, spreads all DoTs to nearby enemies.

Name: Buff_Demonic_Rage
Description: When your health falls below 25%, you become immune to crowd control and deal 100% more damage for 10 seconds.

Name: Buff_Sanctified_Power
Description: A stack gained every 5 seconds. When an attack is blocked, all of your skills are instantly refreshed.

Name: Buff_Temporal_Flux
Description: A stack gained every 30 seconds. When a skill is used, it is cast a random number of times.

Name: Buff_Void
Description: At 10 stacks, your next ability costs no mana and deals 100% more damage.

Name: Buff_Death
Description: Every 10 seconds, when a skill is used, it has a 25% chance to instantly kill an enemy below 50% health.

Name: Buff_Spellslinger
Description: Each stack reduces the mana cost of your abilities by 10%.

Name: Buff_Dervish
Description: Increases your attack speed by 10% per stack.

Name: Buff_Famished
Description: Increases all of your leech by 5%.

Name: Buff_Divine_Aegis
Description: Gain a divine shield when below 50% HP, reducing all damage taken by 75%.

Name: Buff_Commander
Description: All nearby allies gain 20% increased movement speed and attack speed.

Name: Buff_Chaotic_Barrier
Description: Temporarily grants a random buff when attacked.

Name: Buff_The_Ascended
Description: When you kill an enemy, your minions deal 10% more damage and have 10% increased attack speed for 5 seconds. (planned) As an enemy's buff: a powerful buff granted to all nearby enemies when this enemy is killed.

Name: Buff_Feasting
Description: This enemy gains a stack of "Feasting" every time it is hit, up to 5 stacks, and for every stack its attack speed is increased by 4%. A stack lasts 5 seconds.

Name: Debuff_Withered_Touch
Description: Reduces the player's damage by 20%, and their maximum mana and maximum energy shield by 20%, for 5 seconds.

Name: Debuff_Haunting
Description: (planned) A debuff applied by a spectral copy of an enemy that reduces all of a player's resistances.

Name: Debuff_Wither
Description: At 10 stacks of Withering, reduces the player's movement and attack speed by 30% for 4 seconds, and every stack of Withering is spent.

Name: Debuff_Infernal_Brand
Description: A stacking debuff that explodes at 5 stacks, dealing a large amount of fire damage to the player.

Name: Debuff_Abyssal_Aura
Description: A debuff that reduces the player's Demonic and War resistances by 25%.

Name: Debuff_Starforged
Description: (planned) A stacking debuff that reduces the player's damage and increases the damage they take.

Name: Debuff_Nullifying
Description: (planned) A debuff that removes a single, random buff from the player.

Name: Debuff_Echoing
Description: (planned) A stacking debuff that reduces the player's damage and movement speed.

Name: Debuff_Reality_Bender
Description: (planned) An effect that inflicts a random debuff on the player.

Name: Debuff_The_Deceiver
Description: (planned) A debuff applied to the player when an illusion is hit.

Name: Debuff_Manic
Description: (planned) An aura of chaos that causes all nearby enemies to deal more damage but also take more damage.

Name: Debuff_Battle_Cry
Description: (planned) A terrifying shout that reduces the player's resistances or armor for 5 seconds.

Name: Debuff_Contagion
Description: (planned) A debuff that mirrors DoTs and debuffs back onto the player.

Name: Debuff_Starving_Aura
Description: An aura that reduces healing and health regeneration effects by 50%.

Name: Debuff_Final_Curse
Description: (planned) Upon death, this enemy curses the player for 5 seconds, causing them to take damage when using abilities.

Name: Debuff_Shared_Pain
Description: (planned) A debuff that distributes damage taken across nearby allies.

Name: Debuff_Soul_Tether
Description: (planned) A debuff that transfers a portion of damage taken to the player as health degeneration over time.

Name: Debuff_Touch_of_Nothing
Description: When a player gains a buff, a stack of this debuff is consumed to negate that buff completely. Up to 5 stacks, kept while the hits that lay them come less than 8 seconds apart.

Name: Debuff_Madness
Description: A player-applied debuff. The affected enemy attacks anything nearby, friend or foe, for 3 seconds. Magnitude extends the duration. Applied by the Of Madness gem (planned) and the chance to madden affix.

Name: Debuff_Cripple
Description: A player-applied debuff. Reduces the affected enemy's movement and attack speed by 30% for 4 seconds. Magnitude raises the reduction to a cap of 80%, then extends the duration instead. Applied by the Of Maiming gem (planned) and the chance to cripple affix.

Name: Debuff_Shred
Description: A player-applied debuff. Reduces the affected enemy's resistance by 10 for 6 seconds. Magnitude raises the reduction until that resistance reaches zero, then extends the duration instead. Applied by the Of Shredding gem (planned) and the chance to shred affix.

Name: Debuff_Weaken
Description: A player-applied debuff. Reduces the affected enemy's damage by 20% for 5 seconds. Magnitude raises the reduction to a cap of 80%, then extends the duration instead. Distinct from Wither, which an enemy applies to the player and which reduces speed rather than damage. Applied by the Of Withering gem (planned) and the chance to weaken affix.

Name: Debuff_Stun
Description: A hard stop. The target cannot act for the stun duration, which is stated by whatever applies it rather than being fixed here: designed skills run 0.75 to 1.5 seconds. A stun applied by a chance rather than by a skill lasts 0.75 seconds at 100% chance to stun and longer above it: chance past 100% multiplies the duration instead of being wasted, so 200% gives 1.5 seconds and 400% gives 3, which is the cap. Nothing reaches further, because a stun as long as the immunity window below would hold a target for ever. Three rules bound it. A hit must take at least 10% of the target maximum health to stun, unless the skill states stunning as its effect. A stunned target cannot be stunned again for 5 seconds. A boss cannot be stunned at all. Stun and Knockdown share one immunity window rather than one each.

Name: Debuff_Knockdown
Description: A hard stop that puts the target on the floor. It stops the target acting for a stated number of seconds, which is the whole of what a stun does, so it carries all three parts of the anti-stun-lock rule in full. Two Ultimates apply it: Warlord's Decree (planned) for 2 seconds and Cataclysm (planned) for 3, both longer than any stun. Knockdown and Stun share one immunity window rather than one each.

Name: Debuff_Quarry
Description: A mark on one enemy. Everything the caster commands breaks off and attacks it, gaining 30% attack speed while the mark holds. If the marked enemy dies first, the mark jumps to the nearest living enemy.

Name: Debuff_Beguiling
Description: A debuff applied by a creature carrying the Beguiling enemy modifier. While it is up the player deals no direct damage to that creature. Area damage still lands.

Name: Debuff_Withering
Description: A stack for each hit from a creature with Withering Blows that takes the player's health, kept while those hits come less than 8 seconds apart. It does nothing itself; at 10 stacks it is removed and the player is given Wither.

Name: DoT_Bleed
Description: A player-applied effect. Deals a base of 20 damage a second for 5 seconds, and ticks only while the affected target is moving, stopping after 4 seconds of movement. That makes it the ailment for a target that has to chase or flee. One stack only. Magnitude scales the damage. War skills apply it directly. Applied by the Primal Instinct enchantment (planned), the Of Rending gem (planned) and the chance to bleed affix.

Name: DoT_Poison
Description: A player-applied effect. Deals a base of 20 damage a second for 8 seconds, the longest of any ailment, so it only pays out in full against a target that survives that long and is the ailment for a boss. One stack only. Magnitude scales the damage. Applied by the Toxic Trail enemy modifier (planned), the Of The Viper gem (planned) and the chance to poison affix.

Name: DoT_Disease
Description: A player-applied effect. Deals a base of 12 damage a second for 6 seconds, and when the affected target dies it spreads its remaining duration to nearby enemies. That makes it the ailment for a pack rather than for one target. One stack only. Magnitude scales the damage. Applied by the Of Rot gem (planned) and the chance to disease affix.

Name: DoT_Burn
Description: A player-applied effect. Deals a base of 25 damage a second for 4 seconds, the shortest and hardest-hitting of the ailments, so it is the one that still pays out against a target dying quickly. One stack only. Magnitude scales the damage. Demonic skills apply it directly. Applied by the Of Embers gem (planned) and the chance to burn affix. The Hellfire Aura enemy modifier applies it to the player.

Name: DoT_Necrosis
Description: A player-applied effect. Deals a base of 10 damage a second for 10 seconds, and denies the affected target all healing for that time, dealing the denied amount as damage over the following 5 seconds. That makes it the ailment for a target that heals. One stack only. Magnitude scales the damage, and because the healing denial is already total at 100% it extends the duration instead of raising that.

Name: DoT_Necrotic_Fog
Description: A dungeon modifier that deals damage over time.

Name: DoT_Void_Splinter
Description: Deals 1% of current HP per second over 4 seconds, so it is the one ailment measured against how much health the target has rather than against the hit or a flat amount, which makes it the ailment for a large health pool. Applied by the Of The Abyss gem (planned).

Name: DoT_Void_Rift
Description: (planned) Enemies create small void zones that deal heavy damage over time to the player.
